description: Gets the debriefing.io links where a person requests a free competitive brief about their own company and competitors, signs up for a workspace, or compares plans. It only returns links. It sends nothing and creates nothing. One email address may request 3 free briefs in 24 hours. Send the person's email, with their consent, to check that limit before you give them the link.

email.description: Optional. The email address the person will use. The answer then says how many free brief requests it has left today.

name: get_free_brief_link

request_limit.description: The daily limit on free brief requests. With an email, also its use today.

title: Get the free brief link
